task_description: Perform a comprehensive end-to-end manual QA audit of the kiro-web-playground Next.js 16 app and produce a full QA audit report (QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md) with all 9 deliverable sections. The app is a single static landing page, so the report must honestly mark absent-feature scope (forms, modals, auth, CRUD, APIs, pagination, etc.) as Not Applicable while thoroughly auditing the real page (markup, accessibility, responsiveness, console/network, links, images, theme/font consistency, security headers, metadata, performance).
